notes.title: Midnight Scenes 2 (Special Edition) Available now!
notes.content:
Midnight Scenes 2 (Special Edition) is now available on Windows and Mac!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1382730/Midnight_Scenes_Episode_2_Special_Edition/]GET IT HERE![/url]

Haven't played Episode 1? Get both 10% off: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16076/Midnight_Scenes_1__2_Bundle/

This new edition includes:
- The original 2018 game with some small visual improvements.
- An Art Book in PDF.
- The Original Soundtrack.
- Localization to 7 languages! (French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese)

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: The Supper - Quick Fix Patch v1.01
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing (or planning to play) The Supper!
I hope you like it :)

Here's a quick patch with some fixes (thanks to Nor Treblig for the bug report):

- Fixed an issue with the camera going out of bounds when the player is on the Pirate Ship.
- Chairs in the dining room are now correctly displayed in front of the player.
- Fixed an issue with the starred background abruptly ending, in the scene with Captain McMurray.
- Fixed an issue where Main Menu wasn't working correctly from the start of the game.
